coordinate_reference_system: WGS84 longitude/latitude. The municipal GeoServer (karta.vdmb.se) reprojects the property polygon to EPSG:4326 for srsName=EPSG:4326; the layer's native CRS is EPSG:3010 (SWEREF99 16 30). The Atlas computes only the planar area centroid of the returned WGS84 ring, applying no coordinate transformation. Cross-check: transforming the native EPSG:3010 polygon with pyproj 3.7.1 reproduces the server vertices within 0.003 m and the centroid within 0.10 m.

extraction.centroid_method: shapely 2.1.1 planar area centroid of the server-returned WGS84 ring

identity_chain: Svenska kraftnät's consultation report for its grid project records consultation response #83 from DSC International, described as part of the Google group. DSC International states that it plans to build a data centre on the property Horndalsbyn 12:28, then undergoing permitting, and that it is majority owner of the access road.
Google's Horndal location page states that construction of its Horndal data centre followed a June 2026 groundbreaking.
Avesta municipality's September 30, 2026 article states that Google has made an investment decision to build a data centre in Horndal, at the Krångede power-infrastructure area.
The municipal map service (Västmanland-Dalarna miljö- och byggförvaltning, karta.vdmb.se) returns exactly one property feature named HORNDALSBYN 12:28 in Avesta, with stated positional error 0.05.
precision: Planar centroid of the 108.8 ha registered property Horndalsbyn 12:28 named by Google's subsidiary as its data-centre property. A campus marker; not a building, entrance, substation or construction-extent location. Other properties Google may have added to the site are not included.
uncertainty_reason: The property boundary's stated positional error is 0.05, but the data-centre buildings' positions within the 108.8 ha property are unmapped and its farthest vertex lies about 1.33 km from the centroid. The marker's uncertainty as a building locator is therefore unquantified.
excluded_geometry: The Horndal village centre, Krångede power station and earlier approximate locality point 60.29, 16.41 are not used. Detailed-plan B17 (Industrimark norr om Horndal) is context only and is not used as geometry.
